description: A conceptual map showing a cluster of water bodies classified as "8.2.3" (Aquaculture ponds) outlined in red, embedded within a light green land cover matrix with scattered light green vegetation features. The water bodies within the red outline are depicted in various shades of blue and grey, suggesting different hydrological features or pond types. Three separate instances of the label "8.2.3" are explicitly visible: one on an isolated, light blue pond in the upper right, one on a mid-blue body of water in the central area, and one on a darker blue water body in the lower right. The overall red outline encompasses these and other interconnected water features. This illustration demonstrates how features classified under a specific Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) nomenclature class, such as "Aquaculture ponds," might appear in a spatial dataset.
